```{r d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1_function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1 <- function(
  file,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  residue_types = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  sheets = residue_types,

  # d-CCSSBU-L baseline settings
  n_stage3A_events = 10,
  target_ARL0 = 740,
  B = 20000,
  c_smooth = 0.5,
  h_min = 0.05,
  seed = 2026,

  # Location-calibration settings
  location_eligibility_threshold = 70,
  location_distinct_digits = 10,

  # Cluster definition
  cluster_col = "USL",
  cluster_group_cols = NULL,
  cluster_round_digits = 10,

  # Common additive location-shift grid
  k_grid = c(
    0.5,
    1.0,
    1.5,
    2.0,
    2.5,
    3.0
  ),

  # Maximum reported ARL when no signals are observed
  T_max = 10000,

  # Conventional Xbar-chart subgroup size
  benchmark_n = NULL,

  # Input columns
  event_col = "Event",
  location_col = "Location",
  result_col = "Result",
  lod_col = "LOD",
  loq_col = "LOQ",
  usl_col = "USL",

  # Numerical comparison tolerance
  comparison_tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),

  # Output
  round_digits = 4,
  verbose = TRUE
) {

  # ============================================================
  # Required packages and functions
  # ============================================================

  required_packages <- c(
    "dplyr",
    "tibble",
    "tidyr"
  )

  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(
      required_packages,
      requireNamespace,
      quietly = TRUE,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_packages,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (!exists("d_ccssbu_l", mode = "function")) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The function d_ccssbu_l() must be defined before ",
        "running d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1()."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    !exists(
      "make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl",
      mode = "function"
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The function make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl() must ",
        "be defined before running ",
        "d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1()."
      )
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Validate arguments
  # ============================================================

  if (length(residue_types) != length(sheets)) {
    stop(
      "residue_types and sheets must have the same length."
    )
  }

  if (length(residue_types) == 0) {
    stop(
      "At least one residue type must be supplied."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(target_ARL0) != 1 ||
    is.na(target_ARL0) ||
    !is.finite(target_ARL0) ||
    target_ARL0 <= 1
  ) {
    stop(
      "target_ARL0 must be a finite number greater than 1."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(B) != 1 ||
    is.na(B) ||
    !is.finite(B) ||
    B <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "B must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  B <- as.integer(
    round(B)
  )

  if (
    length(T_max) != 1 ||
    is.na(T_max) ||
    !is.finite(T_max) ||
    T_max <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "T_max must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  T_max <- as.numeric(T_max)

  if (
    length(comparison_tolerance) != 1 ||
    is.na(comparison_tolerance) ||
    !is.finite(comparison_tolerance) ||
    comparison_tolerance < 0
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "comparison_tolerance must be a finite ",
        "nonnegative number."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(round_digits) != 1 ||
    is.na(round_digits) ||
    !is.finite(round_digits) ||
    round_digits < 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "round_digits must be a finite nonnegative integer."
    )
  }

  round_digits <- as.integer(
    round(round_digits)
  )

  k_grid <- as.numeric(k_grid)

  if (
    length(k_grid) == 0 ||
    anyNA(k_grid) ||
    any(!is.finite(k_grid)) ||
    any(k_grid <= 0)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "k_grid must contain finite positive numeric values. ",
        "The IC value k = 0 is not included in the OC ",
        "curve-comparison grid."
      )
    )
  }

  k_grid <- sort(
    unique(k_grid)
  )

  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0

  z_limit <- stats::qnorm(
    p = 1 - alpha
  )

  # ============================================================
  # General helper functions
  # ============================================================

  collapse_set <- function(x) {

    x <- sort(
      unique(x)
    )

    x <- x[
      !is.na(x)
    ]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return("")
    }

    paste(
      x,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  }

  values_tied <- function(
    x,
    target,
    tolerance = comparison_tolerance
  ) {

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(logical(0))
    }

    if (length(target) != 1 || is.na(target)) {
      return(
        rep(
          FALSE,
          length(x)
        )
      )
    }

    if (is.infinite(target)) {
      return(
        is.infinite(x) &
          sign(x) == sign(target)
      )
    }

    is.finite(x) &
      abs(x - target) <=
        tolerance *
        max(
          1,
          abs(target)
        )
  }

  first_existing_name <- function(
    data,
    candidate_names
  ) {

    if (
      is.null(data) ||
      !is.data.frame(data)
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    matched_names <- candidate_names[
      candidate_names %in% names(data)
    ]

    if (length(matched_names) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    matched_names[[1]]
  }

  first_finite_value <- function(x) {

    if (is.null(x)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    x <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(x)
    )

    x <- x[
      !is.na(x) &
        is.finite(x)
    ]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    x[[1]]
  }

  unique_finite_value <- function(
    x,
    value_label,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    x <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(x)
    )

    x <- unique(
      x[
        !is.na(x) &
          is.finite(x)
      ]
    )

    if (length(x) != 1) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Could not identify exactly one finite ",
          value_label,
          " for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    x[[1]]
  }

  get_list_element <- function(
    object,   candidate_names ) {

    if (is.null(object) ||!is.list(object)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    matched_names <- candidate_names[candidate_names %in% names(object) ]

    if (length(matched_names) == 0) {  return(NULL)  }

    object[[matched_names[[1]]]]
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Extract event-statistics table
  # ============================================================

  extract_event_statistics <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    event_statistics <- get_list_element(
      fit,
      c(
        "event_statistics",
        "event_stats",
        "chart_data",
        "event_level_statistics",
        "event_results"
      )
    )

    if (
      is.null(event_statistics) ||
      !is.data.frame(event_statistics) ||
      nrow(event_statistics) == 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No nonempty event-statistics table was returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_l() for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ". The fit object must contain event_statistics."
        )
      )
    }

    tibble::as_tibble(
      event_statistics
    )
  }

# ============================================================
# Extract bootstrap location statistics L_b^*(d)
# ============================================================


extract_bootstrap_location <- function(
  fit,
  residue_type,
  d_value
) {

  bootstrap_location <- fit$bootstrap_statistics_L

  if (is.null(bootstrap_location)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "bootstrap_statistics_L was not returned by ",
        "d_ccssbu_l() for residue ",
        residue_type,
        " and d = ",
        d_value,
        ". Run d_ccssbu_l() with ",
        "keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE."
      )
    )
  }

  bootstrap_location <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      bootstrap_location
    )
  )

  bootstrap_location <- bootstrap_location[
    !is.na(bootstrap_location) &
      is.finite(bootstrap_location)
  ]

  if (length(bootstrap_location) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "No finite bootstrap location statistics were found ",
        "in bootstrap_statistics_L for residue ",
        residue_type,
        " and d = ",
        d_value,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  bootstrap_location
}

# ============================================================
# Extract q
# ============================================================

extract_q <- function(
  fit,
  residue_type
) {

  q_value <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      fit$q
    )
  )

  if (
    length(q_value) != 1 ||
    is.na(q_value) ||
    !is.finite(q_value) ||
    q_value < 1
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "A valid q value was not returned by d_ccssbu_l() ",
        "for residue ",
        residue_type,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  q_integer <- as.integer(
    round(q_value)
  )

  if (
    abs(q_value - q_integer) >
      comparison_tolerance
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The returned q value is not an integer for residue ",
        residue_type,
        ": q = ",
        q_value,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  q_integer
}
  # ============================================================
  # Extract CL and UCL
  # ============================================================


extract_chart_limit <- function(
  fit,
  limit_type,
  residue_type,
  d_value
) {

  if (identical(limit_type, "CL")) {

    limit_value <- fit$CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot

  } else if (identical(limit_type, "UCL")) {

    limit_value <- fit$UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot

  } else {

    stop(
      "limit_type must be either CL or UCL."
    )
  }

  limit_value <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      limit_value
    )
  )

  if (
    length(limit_value) != 1 ||
    is.na(limit_value) ||
    !is.finite(limit_value)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "A finite ",
        limit_type,
        " was not returned by d_ccssbu_l() for residue ",
        residue_type,
        " and d = ",
        d_value,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  limit_value
}


# ============================================================
# Extract calibration case
# ============================================================

extract_calibration_case <- function(
  fit,
  residue_type,
  d_value
) {

  calibration_case <- as.character(
    fit$case_label
  )

  calibration_case <- calibration_case[
    !is.na(calibration_case) &
      nzchar(
        trimws(calibration_case)
      )
  ]

  if (length(calibration_case) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "case_label was not returned by d_ccssbu_l() for ",
        "residue ",
        residue_type,
        " and d = ",
        d_value,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  calibration_case[[1]]
}


  # ============================================================
# Extract calibration size nCal
# ============================================================

extract_n_cal <- function(
  fit,
  residue_type,
  d_value
) {

  n_cal <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      fit$n_Cal
    )
  )

  if (
    length(n_cal) != 1 ||
    is.na(n_cal) ||
    !is.finite(n_cal) ||
    n_cal < 1
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "A valid n_Cal value was not returned by ",
        "d_ccssbu_l() for residue ",
        residue_type,
        " and d = ",
        d_value,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  n_cal_integer <- as.integer(
    round(n_cal)
  )

  if (
    abs(n_cal - n_cal_integer) >
      comparison_tolerance
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The returned n_Cal value is not an integer for ",
        "residue ",
        residue_type,
        " and d = ",
        d_value,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  n_cal_integer
}


# ============================================================
# Extract observed OOC counts
# ============================================================

extract_ooc_counts <- function(
  fit,
  residue_type,
  d_value
) {

  validate_ooc_count <- function(
    value,
    value_name
  ) {

    value <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(value)
    )

    if (
      length(value) != 1 ||
      is.na(value) ||
      !is.finite(value) ||
      value < 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "A valid ",
          value_name,
          " value was not returned by d_ccssbu_l() for ",
          "residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    value_integer <- as.integer(
      round(value)
    )

    if (
      abs(value - value_integer) >
        comparison_tolerance
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          value_name,
          " is not an integer for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    value_integer
  }

  OOC_ND <- validate_ooc_count(
    value = fit$n_ND_ooc,
    value_name = "n_ND_ooc"
  )

  OOC_3A <- validate_ooc_count(
    value = fit$n_stage3A_ooc,
    value_name = "n_stage3A_ooc"
  )

  OOC_3B <- validate_ooc_count(
    value = fit$n_stage3B_ooc,
    value_name = "n_stage3B_ooc"
  )

  list(
    OOC_ND = OOC_ND,
    OOC_3A = OOC_3A,
    OOC_3B = OOC_3B
  )
}
  # ============================================================
  # Conventional Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark
  #
  # Under X_i ~ N(k, 1):
  #
  # p1 = 1 - Phi(z_limit - k * sqrt(n))
  #
  # ARL1 = 1 / p1
  # ============================================================

  conventional_xbar_chart_arl1 <- function(
    k_value,
    n,
    z_value = z_limit
  ) {

    if (
      length(k_value) != 1 ||
      is.na(k_value) ||
      !is.finite(k_value) ||
      k_value < 0
    ) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    if (
      length(n) != 1 ||
      is.na(n) ||
      !is.finite(n) ||
      n < 1
    ) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    if (
      length(z_value) != 1 ||
      is.na(z_value) ||
      !is.finite(z_value)
    ) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    n <- as.integer(
      round(n)
    )

    p1_xbar <- stats::pnorm(
      q = z_value - k_value * sqrt(n),
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )

    if (is.na(p1_xbar)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    if (p1_xbar <= 0) {
      return(Inf)
    }

    1 / p1_xbar
  }

  # ============================================================
# Determine benchmark subgroup size
# ============================================================

get_benchmark_n <- function(
  residue_type,
  residue_position,
  event_statistics
) {

  if (is.null(benchmark_n)) {

    n_col <- first_existing_name(
      event_statistics,
      c(
        "n_locations_observed",
        "n_locations",
        "n_sampling_locations",
        "subgroup_size"
      )
    )

    if (is.null(n_col)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No observed number-of-locations column was found ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_type,
          ". Provide benchmark_n explicitly."
        )
      )
    }

    observed_n <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        event_statistics[[n_col]]
      )
    )

    observed_n <- observed_n[
      !is.na(observed_n) &
        is.finite(observed_n) &
        observed_n >= 1
    ]

    if (length(observed_n) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No finite positive location counts were found for ",
          "residue ",
          residue_type,
          ". Provide benchmark_n explicitly."
        )
      )
    }

    benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(
      round(
        stats::median(
          observed_n
        )
      )
    )

  } else if (
    !is.null(names(benchmark_n)) &&
    residue_type %in% names(benchmark_n)
  ) {

    benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(
      benchmark_n[[residue_type]]
    )

  } else if (length(benchmark_n) == 1) {

    benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(
      benchmark_n[[1]]
    )

  } else if (
    length(benchmark_n) == length(residue_types)
  ) {

    benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(
      benchmark_n[[residue_position]]
    )

  } else {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "benchmark_n must be NULL, a single number, a named ",
        "vector by residue type, or a vector having the same ",
        "length as residue_types."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(benchmark_n_i) != 1 ||
    is.na(benchmark_n_i) ||
    !is.finite(benchmark_n_i) ||
    benchmark_n_i < 1
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The conventional Xbar-chart benchmark requires ",
        "benchmark_n >= 1 for residue ",
        residue_type,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  benchmark_n_i
}
  
  # ============================================================
# Steps 9 to 12: recommend d for one residue type
# ============================================================

recommend_d_for_residue <- function(
  candidate_tbl
) {

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "k",
    "ARL1",
    "Xbar_chart_ARL1"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(candidate_tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The recommendation input is missing column(s): ",
        paste(
          missing_columns,
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }

  if (nrow(candidate_tbl) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "No candidate rows were supplied to the ",
        "recommendation function."
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that the table contains exactly one residue type
  # ==========================================================

  residue_values <- unique(
    as.character(
      candidate_tbl$Residue
    )
  )

  residue_values <- residue_values[
    !is.na(residue_values) &
      nzchar(
        trimws(residue_values)
      )
  ]

  if (length(residue_values) != 1) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "recommend_d_for_residue() requires data from ",
        "exactly one residue type."
      )
    )
  }

  residue_i <- residue_values[[1]]

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that exactly one q value is present
  # ==========================================================

  q_values <- unique(
    suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        candidate_tbl$q
      )
    )
  )

  q_values <- q_values[
    !is.na(q_values) &
      is.finite(q_values)
  ]

  if (length(q_values) != 1) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Exactly one finite q value is required for residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  q_i <- as.integer(
    round(
      q_values[[1]]
    )
  )

  if (q_i < 1) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "q must be at least 1 for residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm candidate d values
  # ==========================================================

  candidate_values <- sort(
    unique(
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          candidate_tbl$d
        )
      )
    )
  )

  candidate_values <- candidate_values[
    !is.na(candidate_values)
  ]

  if (length(candidate_values) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "No valid candidate d values were found for residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  expected_candidates <- seq_len(q_i)

  if (!identical(candidate_values, expected_candidates)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The candidate set for residue ",
        residue_i,
        " must be exactly d = 1, 2, ..., q. Expected: ",
        collapse_set(expected_candidates),
        ". Observed: ",
        collapse_set(candidate_values),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  expected_grid <- sort(
    unique(
      as.numeric(
        k_grid
      )
    )
  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that each d has exactly one row for every k
  # ==========================================================

  grid_check <- candidate_tbl |>
    dplyr::count(
      .data$d,
      .data$k,
      name = "n_rows"
    )

  if (any(grid_check$n_rows != 1)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "At least one residue-d-k combination has duplicate ",
        "rows for residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  for (d_i in candidate_values) {

    observed_grid_i <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$d == d_i
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$k
      )

    observed_grid_i <- sort(
      unique(
        as.numeric(
          observed_grid_i
        )
      )
    )

    if (
      length(observed_grid_i) != length(expected_grid) ||
      any(
        abs(
          observed_grid_i - expected_grid
        ) > comparison_tolerance
      )
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Candidate d = ",
          d_i,
          " for residue ",
          residue_i,
          " does not contain the complete k grid."
        )
      )
    }
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that q and OOC counts are constant across k
  # ==========================================================

  identifier_check <- candidate_tbl |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$d
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_q =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$q
        ),
      n_OOC_ND =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_ND
        ),
      n_OOC_3A =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_3A
        ),
      n_OOC_3B =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_3B
        ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (
    any(identifier_check$n_q != 1) ||
    any(identifier_check$n_OOC_ND != 1) ||
    any(identifier_check$n_OOC_3A != 1) ||
    any(identifier_check$n_OOC_3B != 1)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Candidate-specific q or OOC counts vary across k ",
        "for residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Step 10 components: calculate R(d,k), W(d), and G(d)
  # ==========================================================

  candidate_metrics <- candidate_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      R =
        .data$ARL1 /
        .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$Residue,
      .data$d,
      .data$q
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      OOC_ND =
        dplyr::first(
          .data$OOC_ND
        ),
      OOC_3A =
        dplyr::first(
          .data$OOC_3A
        ),
      OOC_3B =
        dplyr::first(
          .data$OOC_3B
        ),
      all_R_valid =
        all(
          !is.na(.data$R) &
            is.finite(.data$R) &
            .data$R > 0
        ),
      W = if (
        all(
          !is.na(.data$R) &
            is.finite(.data$R) &
            .data$R > 0
        )
      ) {
        max(.data$R )
      } else {NA_real_},
      G = if (
        all(
          !is.na(.data$R) &
            is.finite(.data$R) &
            .data$R > 0
        )
      ) {
        exp(
          mean(
            log(
              .data$R
            )
          )
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop") |>dplyr::arrange(.data$d)

  if (
    any(!candidate_metrics$all_R_valid) ||
    anyNA(candidate_metrics$W) ||
    anyNA(candidate_metrics$G) ||
    any(!is.finite(candidate_metrics$W)) ||
    any(!is.finite(candidate_metrics$G))
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "At least one relative ARL curve contains an ",
        "undefined, nonfinite, or nonpositive ratio for ",
        "residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  C_d <- sort(unique(candidate_metrics$d))

  # ==========================================================
  # Step 9. Define D1, D2, and A
  # ==========================================================

  D1 <- candidate_metrics |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$OOC_ND == 0
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(
      .data$d
    )

  D1 <- sort( unique(D1))

  D2 <- candidate_metrics |>dplyr::filter(.data$OOC_3A == 0) |> dplyr::pull(.data$d)

  D2 <- sort(unique(D2) )

  D12 <- sort(intersect(D1, D2))

  if (length(D12) > 0) {

    observed_behavior_case <-
      "D1_intersect_D2"

    A <- D12

  } else if (length(D1) > 0) {

    observed_behavior_case <- "D1"

    A <- D1

  } else if (length(D2) > 0) {

    observed_behavior_case <- "D2"

    A <- D2

  } else {

    observed_behavior_case <- "C_d"

    A <- C_d
  }

  A <- sort(
    unique(A)
  )

  if (length(A) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The operationally admissible set A is empty for ",
        "residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  metrics_A <- candidate_metrics |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$d %in% A
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$d
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # Step 10. Define U
  # ==========================================================

  U <- metrics_A |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$W <=
        1 + comparison_tolerance
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(
      .data$d
    )

  U <- sort(
    unique(U)
  )

  tied_W_d <- integer(0)
  tied_G_d <- integer(0)

  minimum_W <- NA_real_
  minimum_G <- NA_real_

  # ==========================================================
  # Step 11. Apply the U or XO selection rule
  # ==========================================================

  if (length(U) > 0) {

    arl_curve_case <- "U"

    d_rec <- as.integer(
      max(U)
    )

    selection_rule <-
      "U case: maximum d in U"

  } else {

    arl_curve_case <- "XO"

    minimum_W <- min(
      metrics_A$W,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    tied_W_d <- metrics_A |>
      dplyr::filter(
        values_tied(
          .data$W,
          minimum_W
        )
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      )

    tied_W_d <- sort(
      unique(tied_W_d)
    )

    if (length(tied_W_d) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No candidate attained the minimum W for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    metrics_W_tie <- metrics_A |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$d %in% tied_W_d
      )

    minimum_G <- min(
      metrics_W_tie$G,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    tied_G_d <- metrics_W_tie |>
      dplyr::filter(
        values_tied(
          .data$G,
          minimum_G
        )
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      )

    tied_G_d <- sort(
      unique(tied_G_d)
    )

    if (length(tied_G_d) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No candidate attained the minimum G among ",
          "candidates tied on W for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    d_rec <- as.integer(
      max(tied_G_d)
    )

    selection_rule <- paste0(
      "XO case: minimum W over A; minimum G among ",
      "candidates tied on W; maximum d if a tie remains"
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Extract the selected candidate's W and G
  # ==========================================================

  selected_metrics <- metrics_A |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$d == d_rec
    )

  if (nrow(selected_metrics) != 1) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The selected candidate metrics could not be ",
        "uniquely identified for residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  selected_W <- selected_metrics$W[[1]]
  selected_G <- selected_metrics$G[[1]]

  # ==========================================================
  # Step 12. Assign exactly one of the eight cases
  # ==========================================================

  case_key <- paste(
    observed_behavior_case,
    arl_curve_case,
    sep = "|"
  )

  case_lookup <- c(
    "D1_intersect_D2|U" = "Case 1",
    "D1_intersect_D2|XO" = "Case 2",
    "D1|U" = "Case 3",
    "D1|XO" = "Case 4",
    "D2|U" = "Case 5",
    "D2|XO" = "Case 6",
    "C_d|U" = "Case 7",
    "C_d|XO" = "Case 8"
  )

  selected_case <- unname(
    case_lookup[case_key]
  )

  if (
    length(selected_case) != 1 ||
    is.na(selected_case)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The eight-case decision path could not be assigned ",
        "for residue ",
        residue_i,
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct recommendation notes
  # ==========================================================

  notes <- character(0)

  if (length(D1) == 0) {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste0(
        "D1 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
        "one ND event as OOC."
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(D2) == 0) {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste0(
        "D2 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
        "one nominal Stage 3A event as OOC."
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(U) == 0) {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste0(
        "U is empty: every candidate in A has at least one ",
        "k value for which its d-CCSSBU-L ARL1 exceeds the ",
        "corresponding Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    arl_curve_case == "XO" &&
    length(tied_W_d) > 1
  ) {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste0(
        "Candidate d values ",
        collapse_set(tied_W_d),
        " attained the same minimum W value."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    arl_curve_case == "XO" &&
    length(tied_G_d) > 1
  ) {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste0(
        "Candidate d values ",
        collapse_set(tied_G_d),
        " remained tied after comparing G. The largest ",
        "tied value of d was selected."
      )
    )
  }

  if (arl_curve_case == "U") {
    notes <- c(
      notes,
      paste0(
        "The largest d in U was selected because every ",
        "candidate in U has an ARL1 curve that remains below ",
        "or touches the Xbar-chart benchmark throughout the ",
        "complete k grid."
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Recommendation table
  # ==========================================================

  recommendation_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    Residue =      residue_i,

    recommended_d =      d_rec,

    q =      q_i,

    observed_behavior_case =      observed_behavior_case,

    arl_curve_case =      arl_curve_case,

    selected_case =      selected_case,

    selection_rule =      selection_rule,

    C_d_values =      collapse_set(C_d),

    D1_values =      collapse_set(D1),

    D2_values =      collapse_set(D2),

    A_values =      collapse_set(A),

    U_values =      collapse_set(U),

    W_tied_d_values =      collapse_set(tied_W_d),

    G_tied_d_values =      collapse_set(tied_G_d),

    minimum_W =      minimum_W,

    minimum_G_among_W_ties =      minimum_G,

    recommended_W =      selected_W,

    recommended_G =      selected_G,

    selection_path = paste0(selected_case," | ",observed_behavior_case, " | ",
      arl_curve_case,  " | ",  selection_rule ),

    recommendation_notes = paste(  notes,  collapse = " | "  )
  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Add set membership and selected-candidate indicators
  # ==========================================================

  candidate_metrics_output <- candidate_metrics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      in_C_d =        .data$d %in% C_d,

      in_D1 =        .data$d %in% D1,

      in_D2 =        .data$d %in% D2,

      in_A =        .data$d %in% A,

      in_U =        .data$d %in% U,

      selected =        .data$d == d_rec
    )

  list(
    recommendation =      recommendation_tbl,

    candidate_metrics =      candidate_metrics_output
  )
}

  # ============================================================
# Steps 1 to 8. Fit all residues and candidate d values
# ============================================================

all_rows <- list()
all_fit_objects <- list()
all_candidate_information <- list()

row_id <- 1L
fit_id <- 1L

for (rr in seq_along(residue_types)) {

  residue_type_i <- as.character(
    residue_types[[rr]]
  )

  sheet_i <- sheets[[rr]]

  if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
    message(
      "Processing residue type: ",
      residue_type_i,
      " | sheet: ",
      sheet_i
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 1. Initial d = 1 fit to determine q
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fit_q <- d_ccssbu_l(
    file = file,
    equipment_label = equipment_label,
    residue_type = residue_type_i,
    sheet = sheet_i,
    d = 1,
    n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
    target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
    B = B,
    c_smooth = c_smooth,
    h_min = h_min,
    seed = seed + 1000L * rr + 1L,
    location_eligibility_threshold =
      location_eligibility_threshold,
    location_distinct_digits =
      location_distinct_digits,
    cluster_col = cluster_col,
    cluster_group_cols =
      cluster_group_cols,
    cluster_round_digits =
      cluster_round_digits,
    event_col = event_col,
    location_col = location_col,
    result_col = result_col,
    lod_col = lod_col,
    loq_col = loq_col,
    usl_col = usl_col,
    plot_chart = FALSE,
    save_outputs = FALSE,
    return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
    keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE
  )

  event_statistics_q <- extract_event_statistics(
    fit = fit_q,
    residue_type = residue_type_i,
    d_value = 1
  )

  q_residue <- extract_q(
    fit = fit_q,
    residue_type = residue_type_i
  )

  if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
    message(
      "  Number of calibration-eligible ordered clusters q = ",
      q_residue
    )
  }

  # The Xbar-chart benchmark subgroup size is fixed
  # within each residue type.

  benchmark_n_i <- get_benchmark_n(
    residue_type = residue_type_i,
    residue_position = rr,
    event_statistics = event_statistics_q
  )

  xbar_benchmark_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    k = k_grid,
    Xbar_chart_ARL1 = vapply(
      k_grid,
      conventional_xbar_chart_arl1,
      n = benchmark_n_i,
      FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
    )
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Fit d = 1, 2, ..., q
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (d_i in seq_len(q_residue)) {

    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
      message(
        "  Fitting d = ",
        d_i,
        " of ",
        q_residue
      )
    }

    if (d_i == 1L) {

      fit_i <- fit_q

    } else {

      fit_i <- d_ccssbu_l(
        file = file,
        equipment_label = equipment_label,
        residue_type = residue_type_i,
        sheet = sheet_i,
        d = d_i,
        n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
        target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
        B = B,
        c_smooth = c_smooth,
        h_min = h_min,
        seed = seed + 1000L * rr + d_i,
        location_eligibility_threshold =
          location_eligibility_threshold,
        location_distinct_digits =
          location_distinct_digits,
        cluster_col = cluster_col,
        cluster_group_cols =
          cluster_group_cols,
        cluster_round_digits =
          cluster_round_digits,
        event_col = event_col,
        location_col = location_col,
        result_col = result_col,
        lod_col = lod_col,
        loq_col = loq_col,
        usl_col = usl_col,
        plot_chart = FALSE,
        save_outputs = FALSE,
        return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
        keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE
      )
    }

    event_statistics_i <- extract_event_statistics(
      fit = fit_i,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      d_value = d_i
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2. Extract calibration and bootstrap information
    # --------------------------------------------------------


CL_i <- extract_chart_limit(
  fit = fit_i,
  limit_type = "CL",
  residue_type = residue_type_i,
  d_value = d_i
)

UCL_i <- extract_chart_limit(
  fit = fit_i,
  limit_type = "UCL",
  residue_type = residue_type_i,
  d_value = d_i
)


    calibration_case_i <- extract_calibration_case(
  fit = fit_i,
  residue_type = residue_type_i,
  d_value = d_i
)
    n_cal_i <- extract_n_cal(
      fit = fit_i,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      d_value = d_i
    )
    
   calibration_data_i <-
  fit_i$calibration_data

calibration_status_i <-
  fit_i$cluster_calibration_status

    bootstrap_location_i <- extract_bootstrap_location(
      fit = fit_i,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      d_value = d_i
    )

    n_bootstrap_i <- length(
      bootstrap_location_i
    )

    if (
      n_bootstrap_i != B &&
      isTRUE(verbose)
    ) {
      message(
        "    Note: requested B = ",
        B,
        ", but ",
        n_bootstrap_i,
        " finite bootstrap location statistics were returned."
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 3. Evaluate observed OOC behavior
    # --------------------------------------------------------
 ooc_counts_i <- extract_ooc_counts(
  fit = fit_i,
  residue_type = residue_type_i,
  d_value = d_i
)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 4 to 6. Apply additive shifts and estimate ARL1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    n_signals_i <- vapply(
      k_grid,
      function(k_value) {
        sum(
          bootstrap_location_i + k_value > UCL_i,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },
      FUN.VALUE = integer(1)
    )

    p1_i <- n_signals_i / n_bootstrap_i

    ARL1_uncensored_i <- ifelse(
      p1_i > 0,
      1 / p1_i,
      Inf
    )

    ARL1_i <- pmin(
      ARL1_uncensored_i,
      T_max
    )

    ARL1_censored_i <-
      !is.finite(ARL1_uncensored_i) |
      ARL1_uncensored_i > T_max

    candidate_shift_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      k = k_grid,
      n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap_i,
      n_signals = n_signals_i,
      p1 = p1_i,
      ARL1_uncensored = ARL1_uncensored_i,
      ARL1 = ARL1_i,
      ARL1_censored = ARL1_censored_i
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Optional IC calibration check at k = 0
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    p0_hat_i <- mean(
      bootstrap_location_i > UCL_i,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    ARL0_hat_uncensored_i <- if (
      p0_hat_i > 0
    ) {
      1 / p0_hat_i
    } else {
      Inf
    }

    ARL0_hat_i <- min(
      ARL0_hat_uncensored_i,
      T_max
    )

    ARL0_censored_i <-
      !is.finite(ARL0_hat_uncensored_i) ||
      ARL0_hat_uncensored_i > T_max

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 7 and 8. Add Xbar benchmark and summarize
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    candidate_rows_i <- candidate_shift_tbl |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        xbar_benchmark_tbl,
        by = "k"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Equipment =
          equipment_label,
        Residue =
          residue_type_i,
        sheet =
          as.character(sheet_i),
        d =
          as.integer(d_i),
        q =
          as.integer(q_residue),
        calibration_case =
          calibration_case_i,
        nCal =
          as.integer(n_cal_i),
        OOC_ND =
          as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_ND),
        OOC_3A =
          as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3A),
        OOC_3B =
          as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3B),
        benchmark_n =
          as.integer(benchmark_n_i),
        target_ARL0 =
          target_ARL0,
        alpha =
          alpha,
        z_limit =
          z_limit,
        CL =
          CL_i,
        UCL =
          UCL_i,
        p0_hat =
          p0_hat_i,
        ARL0_hat_uncensored =
          ARL0_hat_uncensored_i,
        ARL0_hat =
          ARL0_hat_i,
        ARL0_censored =
          ARL0_censored_i,
        T_max =
          T_max,
        .before = 1
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        relative_ARL_ratio =
          .data$ARL1 /
          .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1
      )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Store candidate results
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    all_rows[[row_id]] <- candidate_rows_i

    fit_object_name <- paste0(
      residue_type_i,
      "_d",
      d_i
    )

    all_fit_objects[[fit_id]] <- fit_i

    names(
      all_fit_objects
    )[[fit_id]] <- fit_object_name

    all_candidate_information[[fit_id]] <- list(
      Residue =        residue_type_i,
      d =        as.integer(d_i),
      q =        as.integer(q_residue),
      calibration_case =        calibration_case_i,
      nCal =        as.integer(n_cal_i),
      calibration_data =  calibration_data_i,
      calibration_status =  calibration_status_i,
      CL =        CL_i,
      UCL =        UCL_i,
      OOC_ND =        as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_ND),
      OOC_3A =        as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3A),
      OOC_3B =        as.integer(ooc_counts_i$OOC_3B),
      benchmark_n =        as.integer(benchmark_n_i),
      bootstrap_location_statistics =        bootstrap_location_i,
      event_statistics =        event_statistics_i
    )

    names(
      all_candidate_information
    )[[fit_id]] <- fit_object_name

    row_id <- row_id + 1L
    fit_id <- fit_id + 1L
  }
}

if (length(all_rows) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No candidate-specific ARL1 results were generated."
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Combine Steps 1 to 8 results
# ============================================================

arl1_long_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  all_rows
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(
      .data$Residue,
      residue_types
    ),
    .data$d,
    .data$k
  )

# ============================================================
# Apply Steps 9 to 12 separately by residue
# ============================================================

arl1_split <- split(
  arl1_long_tbl,
  factor(
    arl1_long_tbl$Residue,
    levels = residue_types
  ),
  drop = TRUE
)

recommendation_outputs <- lapply(
  arl1_split,
  recommend_d_for_residue
)

recommendation_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    recommendation_outputs,
    function(x) {
      x$recommendation
    }
  )
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(
      .data$Residue,
      residue_types
    )
  )

candidate_metrics_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    recommendation_outputs,
    function(x) {
      x$candidate_metrics
    }
  )
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(
      .data$Residue,
      residue_types
    ),
    .data$d
  )

# ============================================================
# Add W, G, set memberships, and recommendation information
# to the long-format output
# ============================================================

arl1_long_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    candidate_metrics_tbl |>
      dplyr::select(
        .data$Residue,
        .data$d,
        .data$W,
        .data$G,
        .data$in_C_d,
        .data$in_D1,
        .data$in_D2,
        .data$in_A,
        .data$in_U,
        .data$selected
      ),
    by = c(
      "Residue",
      "d"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    recommendation_tbl |>
      dplyr::select(
        .data$Residue,
        .data$recommended_d,
        .data$observed_behavior_case,
        .data$arl_curve_case,
        .data$selected_case,
        .data$selection_rule,
        .data$A_values,
        .data$U_values,
        .data$selection_path,
        .data$recommendation_notes
      ),
    by = "Residue"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(
      .data$Residue,
      residue_types
    ),
    .data$d,
    .data$k
  )

# ============================================================
# Construct the compact wide ARL1 table
# ============================================================

arl1_wide_tbl <- make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl(
  arl1_long_tbl
)

# ============================================================
# Extract recommended d values
# ============================================================

recommended_d_named <- stats::setNames(
  as.integer(recommendation_tbl$recommended_d), recommendation_tbl$Residue)

DAR_d <- if (
  "DAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)
) {
  as.integer(
    recommended_d_named[["DAR"]]
  )
} else {
  NA_integer_
}

CAR_d <- if (
  "CAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)
) {
  as.integer(
    recommended_d_named[["CAR"]]
  )
} else {
  NA_integer_
}

Mic_d <- if (
  "Mic" %in% names(recommended_d_named)
) {
  as.integer(
    recommended_d_named[["Mic"]]
  )
} else {
  NA_integer_
}

# ============================================================
# Rounded display versions
# ============================================================

numeric_columns_long <- names(
  arl1_long_tbl
)[
  vapply(
    arl1_long_tbl,
    is.numeric,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]

long_display_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(
        numeric_columns_long
      ),
      function(x) {
        round(
          x,
          digits = round_digits
        )
      }
    )
  )

numeric_columns_recommendation <- names(
  recommendation_tbl
)[
  vapply(
    recommendation_tbl,
    is.numeric,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]

recommendation_display_tbl <- recommendation_tbl |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(
        numeric_columns_recommendation
      ),
      function(x) {
        round(
          x,
          digits = round_digits
        )
      }
    )
  )

numeric_columns_metrics <- names(
  candidate_metrics_tbl
)[
  vapply(
    candidate_metrics_tbl,
    is.numeric,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]

candidate_metrics_display_tbl <- candidate_metrics_tbl |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(
        numeric_columns_metrics
      ),
      function(x) {
        round(
          x,
          digits = round_digits
        )
      }
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Completion messages
# ============================================================

if (isTRUE(verbose)) {

  message(
    "Completed d-CCSSBU-L d selection."
  )

  for (ii in seq_len(nrow(recommendation_tbl))) {

    message(
      "  ",
      recommendation_tbl$Residue[[ii]],
      ": recommended d = ",
      recommendation_tbl$recommended_d[[ii]],
      " | ",
      recommendation_tbl$selected_case[[ii]],
      " | ",
      recommendation_tbl$arl_curve_case[[ii]]
    )
  }
}
  
  # ============================================================
  # Return all results
  # ============================================================

  return(
    list(
      recommendations =        recommendation_tbl,

      recommendations_display =        recommendation_display_tbl,

      recommended_d =        recommended_d_named,

      DAR_d =        DAR_d,

      CAR_d =        CAR_d,

      Mic_d =        Mic_d,

      candidate_metrics =        candidate_metrics_tbl,

      candidate_metrics_display =        candidate_metrics_display_tbl,

      arl1_long =        arl1_long_tbl,

      arl1_long_display =        long_display_tbl,

      arl1_wide =        arl1_wide_tbl,

      fit_objects =        all_fit_objects,

      candidate_information =        all_candidate_information,

      benchmark_settings = list(
        target_ARL0 =          target_ARL0,
        alpha =          alpha,
        z_limit =          z_limit,
        k_grid =          k_grid,
        benchmark_n =          benchmark_n,
        T_max =          T_max
      ),

      call =        match.call()
    )
  )
}

```

```{r render_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_tbl_function}
#| echo: false

render_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = paste0(
    "d-CCSSBU-L and conventional Xbar-chart ARL1 results ",
    "over the additive location-shift grid."
  ),
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7
) {

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop("tbl must be a data frame.")
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop("tbl contains no rows.")
  }

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    table_output <- tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label,
        escape = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

  } else {

    table_output <- tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        escape = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover",
          "responsive"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )
  }

  cat(
    as.character(table_output),
    "\n"
  )

  invisible(tbl)
}
```

```{r render_d_ccssbu_l_recommendation_tbl_function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
render_d_ccssbu_l_recommendation_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = paste0(
    "Recommended d values for the d-CCSSBU-L chart ",
    "under the eight-case selection procedure."
  ),
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7,
  show_notes = FALSE
) {

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop("tbl must be a data frame.")
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop("tbl contains no rows.")
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "recommended_d",
    "q",
    "observed_behavior_case",
    "arl_curve_case",
    "selected_case",
    "selection_rule",
    "A_values",
    "U_values",
    "recommended_W",
    "recommended_G",
    "recommendation_notes"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  escape_latex_text <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""

    placeholder <- "BACKSLASHPLACEHOLDER"

    x <- gsub(
      "\\\\",
      placeholder,
      x
    )

    x <- gsub(
      "([#$%&_{}])",
      "\\\\\\1",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub(
      "~",
      "\\\\textasciitilde{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub(
      "^",
      "\\\\textasciicircum{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub(
      placeholder,
      "\\\\textbackslash{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x
  }

  format_set <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""

    ifelse(
      nzchar(trimws(x)),
      paste0(
        "{",
        x,
        "}"
      ),
      "Empty"
    )
  }

  display_observed_case <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)

    dplyr::case_when(
      x == "D1_intersect_D2" ~
        "D1 intersection D2",
      x == "D1" ~ "D1",
      x == "D2" ~ "D2",
      x == "C_d" ~ "C_d",
      TRUE ~ x
    )
  }

  tbl_display <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue =
        as.character(Residue),
      `Recommended d` =
        recommended_d,
      q =
        q,
      `Decision case` =
        as.character(selected_case),
      `Observed-behavior case` =
        display_observed_case(
          observed_behavior_case
        ),
      `ARL1 case` =
        as.character(arl_curve_case),
      A =
        format_set(A_values),
      U =
        format_set(U_values),
      `W(d)` =
        recommended_W,
      `G(d)` =
        recommended_G,
      `Selection rule` =
        as.character(selection_rule)
    )

  notes_tbl <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue =
        as.character(Residue),
      Note =
        as.character(recommendation_notes)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Note),
      nzchar(trimws(Note))
    )

  alignment <- c(
    "l",
    "c",
    "c",
    "c",
    "l",
    "c",
    "l",
    "l",
    "c",
    "c",
    "l"
  )

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label,
        escape = TRUE,
        align = alignment
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

    cat(
      as.character(table_output),
      "\n"
    )

    if (
      isTRUE(show_notes) &&
        nrow(notes_tbl) > 0
    ) {

      cat("\\vspace{1mm}\n")
      cat("\\begin{minipage}{0.96\\textwidth}\n")
      cat("\\footnotesize\n")
      cat("\\noindent\\textit{Notes.}\n")
      cat("\\begin{description}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\itemsep}{1pt}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\parskip}{0pt}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\parsep}{0pt}\n")
      cat("\\setlength{\\topsep}{2pt}\n")

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(notes_tbl))) {

        residue_i <- escape_latex_text(
          notes_tbl$Residue[[i]]
        )

        note_i <- escape_latex_text(
          notes_tbl$Note[[i]]
        )

        cat(
          paste0(
            "\\item[\\textit{",
            residue_i,
            ":}] ",
            note_i,
            "\n"
          )
        )
      }

      cat("\\end{description}\n")
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
      cat("\n")
    }

  } else {

    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        escape = TRUE,
        align = alignment
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover",
          "responsive"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )

    cat(
      as.character(table_output),
      "\n"
    )

    if (
      isTRUE(show_notes) &&
        nrow(notes_tbl) > 0
    ) {

      cat("\n\n*Notes.*\n\n")

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(notes_tbl))) {

        cat(
          paste0(
            "- *",
           notes_tbl$Residue[[i]],
            ":* ",
            notes_tbl$Note[[i]],
            "\n"
          )
        )
      }

      cat("\n")
    }
  }

  invisible(tbl_display)
}
```

```{r plot-d-ccssbu-l-arl1-curves-function}
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
plot_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_curves <- function(
  tbl,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  output_file = NULL,
  residue_order = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  width = 9,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  y_log10 = TRUE,
  show_points = TRUE,
  base_size = 11
) {

  # ==========================================================
  # Check required packages
  # ==========================================================

  required_packages <- c(
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork"
  )

  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(
      required_packages,
      requireNamespace,
      quietly = TRUE,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Please install the following package(s): ",
        paste(
          missing_packages,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Validate inputs
  # ==========================================================

  if (
    is.null(tbl) ||
    !is.data.frame(tbl) ||
    nrow(tbl) == 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "tbl must be a nonempty data frame."
    )
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "k",
    "ARL1",
    "Xbar_chart_ARL1"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The following required column(s) are missing: ",
        paste(
          missing_columns,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(equipment_label) != 1 ||
    is.na(equipment_label) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(equipment_label))
  ) {
    stop(
      "equipment_label must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(width) != 1 ||
    is.na(width) ||
    !is.finite(width) ||
    width <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "width must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(height) != 1 ||
    is.na(height) ||
    !is.finite(height) ||
    height <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "height must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(dpi) != 1 ||
    is.na(dpi) ||
    !is.finite(dpi) ||
    dpi <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "dpi must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(base_size) != 1 ||
    is.na(base_size) ||
    !is.finite(base_size) ||
    base_size <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "base_size must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  residue_order <- unique(
    as.character(residue_order)
  )

  if (
    length(residue_order) == 0 ||
    anyNA(residue_order) ||
    any(!nzchar(trimws(residue_order)))
  ) {
    stop(
      "residue_order must contain nonempty residue names."
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Prepare plotting data
  # ==========================================================

  plot_data <- tbl |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue = as.character(
        .data$Residue
      ),
      d = suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          .data$d
        )
      ),
      Omega_k = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          .data$k
        )
      ),
      ARL1 = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          .data$ARL1
        )
      ),
      Xbar_chart_ARL1 = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1
        )
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Residue %in% residue_order
    )

  missing_residues <- setdiff(
    residue_order,
    unique(plot_data$Residue)
  )

  if (length(missing_residues) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The following requested residue type(s) are absent: ",
        paste(
          missing_residues,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  invalid_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(.data$d) |
        .data$d < 1 |
        is.na(.data$Omega_k) |
        !is.finite(.data$Omega_k) |
        .data$Omega_k <= 0 |
        is.na(.data$ARL1) |
        .data$ARL1 <= 0 |
        is.na(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1) |
        .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1 <= 0
    )

  if (nrow(invalid_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The plotting data contain missing, invalid, or ",
        "nonpositive values of d, k, ARL1, or ",
        "Xbar_chart_ARL1."
      )
    )
  }

  duplicate_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::count(
      .data$Residue,
      .data$d,
      .data$Omega_k,
      name = "n_rows"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$n_rows > 1
    )

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Multiple rows were found for at least one ",
        "Residue, d, and Omega_k combination."
      )
    )
  }

  benchmark_check <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$Residue,
      .data$Omega_k
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_benchmark_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1
        ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$n_benchmark_values > 1
    )

  if (nrow(benchmark_check) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark varies across d ",
        "for at least one Residue and Omega_k combination."
      )
    )
  }

  nonfinite_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.finite(.data$ARL1) |
        !is.finite(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(nonfinite_rows) > 0) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        nrow(nonfinite_rows),
        " row(s) with infinite ARL1 values were omitted."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$ARL1),
      is.finite(.data$Xbar_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No finite ARL1 values remain for plotting."
    )
  }

  omega_breaks <- sort(
    unique(
      plot_data$Omega_k
    )
  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Make one plot for one residue type
  # ==========================================================

  make_residue_plot <- function(
    residue_name
  ) {

    residue_data <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$Residue == residue_name
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$d,
        .data$Omega_k
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        d_label = factor(
          paste0(
            "d = ",
            .data$d
          ),
          levels = paste0(
            "d = ",
            sort(
              unique(
                .data$d
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )

    if (nrow(residue_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No finite plotting data were found for residue ",
          residue_name,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    benchmark_data <- residue_data |>
      dplyr::select(
        .data$Omega_k,
        .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1
      ) |>
      dplyr::distinct() |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$Omega_k
      )

    residue_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = residue_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = .data$Omega_k,
          y = .data$ARL1,
          color = .data$d_label,
          group = .data$d_label
        ),
        linewidth = 0.85,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

    if (isTRUE(show_points)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
          data = residue_data,
          mapping = ggplot2::aes(
            x = .data$Omega_k,
            y = .data$ARL1,
            color = .data$d_label,
            group = .data$d_label
          ),
          size = 1.8,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
    }

    residue_plot <- residue_plot +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = .data$Omega_k,
          y = .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,
          linetype = "Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark",
          group = 1
        ),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1.3,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = .data$Omega_k,
          y = .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1
        ),
        color = "black",
        shape = 18,
        size = 2.7,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = omega_breaks,
        labels = formatC(
          omega_breaks,
          format = "f",
          digits = 1
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
          "Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark" = "longdash"
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(
          residue_name,
          " ARL1 curves"
        ),
        x = expression(
          "Additive location shift, " * Omega[k]
        ),
        y = expression(
          ARL[1]
        ),
        color = "d-CCSSBU-L candidate"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(
        base_size = base_size
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          hjust = 0
        ),
        panel.grid.minor =
          ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold"
        )
      )

    if (isTRUE(y_log10)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::scale_y_log10()
    }

    residue_plot
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Generate and stack DAR, CAR, and Mic panels
  # ==========================================================

  residue_plots <- lapply(
    residue_order,
    make_residue_plot
  )

  names(
    residue_plots
  ) <- residue_order

  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    residue_plots,
    ncol = 1,
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(
        "d-CCSSBU-L and conventional Xbar-chart ",
        "ARL1 curves for ",
        equipment_label
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Candidate curves versus the conventional ",
        "Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark curve."
      ),
      theme = ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = base_size + 3,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = base_size,
          hjust = 0.5
        )
      )
    ) &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct the output filename
  # ==========================================================

  if (is.null(output_file)) {

    equipment_file_name <- tolower(
      trimws(
        equipment_label
      )
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "[^a-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "-",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "^-+|-+$",
      replacement = "",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    output_file <- paste0(
      "d-ccssbu-l-arl1-curves-",
      equipment_file_name,
      ".png"
    )
  }

  if (
    length(output_file) != 1 ||
    is.na(output_file) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(output_file))
  ) {
    stop(
      "output_file must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (
    !grepl(
      pattern = "\\.png$",
      x = output_file,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) {
    output_file <- paste0(
      output_file,
      ".png"
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Save the combined figure
  # ==========================================================

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_file,
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )

  message(
    paste0(
      "The ARL1 curve figure was saved to: ",
      normalizePath(
        output_file,
        winslash = "/",
        mustWork = FALSE
      )
    )
  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Return all plot objects
  # ==========================================================

  invisible(
    list(
      plot = combined_plot,
      panels = residue_plots,
      DAR = residue_plots[["DAR"]],
      CAR = residue_plots[["CAR"]],
      Mic = residue_plots[["Mic"]],
      output_file = output_file,
      plotting_data = plot_data
    )
  )
}
```


# Application of the functions to Equipment A and B.

## d-CCSSBU-L Selection of $d$ and ARL1 Results for Equipment A

Applying the `d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1()` function in [@Yang2026dccssbu] to Equipment A data produces a list of candidate values of $d$ for each residue type. For a given residue type (e.g., DAR), the output contains $q$ rows, where $q$ is the number of ordered clusters identified.

For each candidate value of $d$, the first $d$ clusters are selected to form the calibration dataset containing `nCal` cleaning events. The calibration dataset is then used in the stratified smoothed bootstrap procedure to estimate the chart UCL.

For the resulting UCL, the numbers of OOC events among ND events (`OOC_ND`), Stage 3A events (`OOC_3A`), and Stage 3B events (`OOC_3B`) are reported. An `OOC_ND > 0` indicates that at least one ND event is identified as OOC. Because ND events represent the best-quality cleaning events, such a result suggests that the calibration dataset may not be representative of the IC process. Similarly, `OOC_3A > 0` may indicate that the selected calibration dataset does not adequately represent an IC Stage 3A process.

For comparison with conventional control charts, the sampling-location size associated with each cleaning event is recorded, and the median value is used as the benchmark subgroup size. This benchmark subgroup size is used to construct the conventional $\bar{X}$ chart and $S$ chart and to calculate the corresponding benchmark $\bar{X}$-chart ARL$_1$ values reported in the table.

Finally, the d-CCSSBU-L chart ARL$_1$ values are calculated for a range of shift magnitudes. For the d-CCSSBU-L chart, the shift size is defined as $\delta_k = k \times \mathrm{UCL}/3$, where $k$ denotes the shift multiplier. The benchmark $\bar{X}$-chart ARL$_1$ values are provided for comparison with the proposed chart.

```{r run-d-selection-arl1-l-equipment-a-wide-v7}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_obj <- d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1(
  file = file,
  equipment_label = "Equipment A",
  residue_types = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  sheets = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  n_stage3A_events = 10,
  target_ARL0 = 740,
  B = 20000,
  T_max = 10000,
  c_smooth = 0.5,
  h_min = 0.05,
  seed = 2026,
  location_eligibility_threshold = 70,
  location_distinct_digits = 10,
  cluster_col = "USL",
  benchmark_n = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_tbl_wide <-
  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_obj$arl1_wide

d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_recommendation <-
  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_obj$recommendation_summary

d_CCSSBU_L_Equipment_A_DAR_d <-
  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_obj$DAR_d

d_CCSSBU_L_Equipment_A_CAR_d <-
  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_obj$CAR_d

d_CCSSBU_L_Equipment_A_Mic_d <-
  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_obj$Mic_d
```

```{r display-d-selection-arl1-l-equipment-a-wide-v7}
  tbl =    d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_A_tbl_wide,
  caption =
    paste0(
      "d-CCSSBU-L ARL1 simulation results ",

    ),

    "d-ccssbu-l-arl1-equipment-a",

)
```

## d-CCSSBU-L Selection of $d$ and ARL1 Results for Equipment B

The `d_ccssbu_l_d_selection_arl1()` function was applied to the Equipment B data using the same procedure described for Equipment A. 

For CAR, the candidate solution with $d=1$ produced OOC ND events (`OOC_ND = 3`). Although all OOC observations were ND, the ordered-cluster algorithm identified two distinct groups of ND events, corresponding to relatively smaller and larger ND values. When only the first cluster was selected for calibration, the calibration dataset became dominated by the smaller ND values, resulting in an excessively small UCL. Consequently, several events containing larger ND values were identified as OOC.

This result illustrates that a calibration dataset should be representative of the IC process, even when all observations are ND. Therefore, the candidate solution with $d=1$ was not considered suitable or the calibration dataset is not representative.

```{r run-d-selection-arl1-l-equipment-b-wide-v7}

#| warning: false

  sheets = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  n_stage3A_events = 10,
  target_ARL0 = 740,
  B = 20000,
  T_max = 10000,
  c_smooth = 0.5,
  h_min = 0.05,
  seed = 2026,
  location_eligibility_threshold = 70,
  location_distinct_digits = 10,
  cluster_col = "USL",
  benchmark_n = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_B_tbl_wide <-
  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_B_obj$arl1_wide

d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_B_recommendation <-
  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_B_obj$recommendation_summary

d_CCSSBU_L_Equipment_B_DAR_d <-

  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_B_obj$CAR_d

  d_CCSSBU_L_ARL1_Equipment_B_obj$Mic_d
```

# d-CCSSBU-S Function

The function `d_ccssbu_s()` uses Excel data as above to generate D-CCSSBU-S chart.

```{r d-ccssbu-s-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d_ccssbu_s <- function(file,
                       equipment_label = "Equipment A",
                       residue_type = "DAR",
                       sheet = residue_type,

                       # d-CCSSBU-S design parameters
                       d = 3,
                       n_stage3A_events = 10,
                       target_ARL0 = 740,
                       B = 20000,
                       c_smooth = 0.5,
                       h_min = 0.05,
                       seed = 123,

                       # Scale-calibration eligibility and distinct-S_t control
                       scale_eligibility_threshold = 70,
                       scale_distinct_digits = 10,

                       # Cluster definition
                       cluster_col = "USL",
                       cluster_group_cols = NULL,
                       cluster_round_digits = 10,

                       # Input columns
                       event_col = "Event",
                       location_col = "Location",
                       result_col = "Result",
                       lod_col = "LOD",
                       loq_col = "LOQ",
                       usl_col = "USL",

                       # Output controls
                       plot_chart = TRUE,
                       save_outputs = TRUE,
                       output_dir = file.path(getwd(), "d_CCSSBU_S_Charts"),
                       return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
                       keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE) {

  required_pkgs <- c(
    "readxl",
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "stringr",
    "readr",
    "matrixStats"
  )

  missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[
    !(required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
  ]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(matrixStats)

  if (target_ARL0 <= 1) {
    stop("target_ARL0 must be greater than 1.")
  }

  if (B <= 0) {
    stop("B must be positive.")
  }

  if (d < 1) {
    stop("d must be a positive integer.")
  }

  if (n_stage3A_events < 1) {
    stop("n_stage3A_events must be a positive integer.")
  }

  if (c_smooth < 0) {
    stop("c_smooth must be nonnegative.")
  }

  if (h_min < 0) {
    stop("h_min must be nonnegative.")
  }

  if (scale_eligibility_threshold <= 0) {
    stop("scale_eligibility_threshold must be positive.")
  }

  if (save_outputs && !dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper functions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mad_unscaled <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    med_x <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)

    median(
      abs(x - med_x),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }

  is_nd_result <- function(x) {
    x_chr <- trimws(toupper(as.character(x)))

    x_chr %in% c(
      "ND",
      "N.D.",
      "N/D",
      "NON-DETECT",
      "NONDETECT",
      "NON DETECT",
      "NOT DETECT"
    )
  }

  extract_event_number <- function(x) {
    x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))

    x_num_direct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))

    x_num_extracted <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x_chr, "\\d+$"))
    )

    dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(x_num_direct) ~ x_num_direct,
      !is.na(x_num_extracted) ~ x_num_extracted,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  }

  fast_quantile <- function(x, probs) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    as.numeric(
      stats::quantile(
        x = x,
        probs = probs,
        na.rm = TRUE,
        type = 7,
        names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  safe_name <- function(x) {
    gsub(
      pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "_",
      x = as.character(x)
    )
  }

  safe_plot_text <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- gsub("_", "-", x)
    x
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Read data
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  all_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

  if (!(sheet %in% all_sheets)) {
    stop(
      "Requested sheet was not found: ",
      sheet,
      ". Available sheets: ",
      paste(all_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  message("d-CCSSBU-S equipment = ", equipment_label)
  message("Residue type = ", residue_type)
  message("Sheet used = ", sheet)
  message("Cluster column = ", cluster_col)
  message(
    "d = ", d,
    "; n_stage3A_events = ", n_stage3A_events,
    "; target ARL0 = ", target_ARL0,
    "; alpha = ", signif(alpha, 5),
    "; B = ", B,
    "; c_smooth = ", c_smooth,
    "; h_min = ", h_min,
    "; scale eligibility threshold = ", scale_eligibility_threshold,
    "; seed = ", seed
  )

  dat_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    path = file,
    sheet = sheet
  )

  dat_raw <- dat_raw %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_trim(.x))
```
